mathematical_oracle: Holdout non-contamination invariant (AGENTS.md §3–§4, CURRENT_STATE.md): once a case or corpus has been inspected during error analysis or rule design (REAL27 including vmmu_r537/r460/r463/r266, COMP112, DEV37, PROBES39, and Stage P1 probes), performance on it measures development fitness and non-regression, never blind generalization.
